# Skelpr

> Surgical code retrieval for AI agents, PR reviews, and fixes. Skelpr finds the
> parts of a repository that matter, ranks them, and hands the agent a small,
> token-efficient context package with precise file:line citations. It retrieves
> and cites — the agent still does the reasoning.

Install is open (`pip install skelpr`); running is licensed per machine through an
offline-verified activation token. Retrieval, indexing and review run locally, and
there is no telemetry. It speaks MCP, so agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity
call it as they are; the CLI covers the same retrieval path for review, diff and fix.

## Docs

- [Install & activate](https://www.skelpr.com/docs): prerequisites, pip install on Linux/macOS/Windows, activation with your token, first run, troubleshooting, uninstall.
- [Home](https://www.skelpr.com/): problem, integration modes, benchmark evidence, requirements, waitlist.

## Evidence

- The repository's MCP Agent A/B: 59% fewer agent tokens and 76% fewer files opened, at answer parity.
- Prerequisites: Python 3.10+, Docker Desktop running, and an embeddings endpoint — the hosted one if the token carries the hosted-embeddings feature, otherwise a local server (LM Studio serving nomic-embed-text-v1.5 by default).
